text:
incident-bot: Paging oncall (rotation: oncall-angel) — high error rate detected: downstream 502/504 surge for /v1/generate across prod-us-west-1 and prod-eu-west-1. ErrorRate > 5% (1m)

oncall-angel: acked — grabbing context. seeing spike on grafana, routing errors up. marking incident in status page.

sam: I’m seeing an increase in gateway 502s that correlate with increased latency from proxy-cache. top upstream: edge-proxy-01.

iris: any recent deploys in the last 30m?

oncall-angel: no code deploys flagged by deploy-bot in last 60m. config changes? none in infra PRs merged recently.

eng-sre-lead: quick ask: are failures uniformly across models or specific to long-seq requests?

sam: failures skew to longer seq lengths >2048 and requests with heavy KV cache usage.

oncall-angel: quick mitigation: - enable fallback route to west-2 regional pool for traffic from west-1, - temporarily increase gateway timeout from 10s -> 20s for /v1/generate, - scale up proxy-cache replicas by +2. executing now.

prod-support-bot: Route change submitted: traffic-split set to 80% prod-us-west-1, 20% prod-west-2 fallback. Change id: change-3821.

oncall-angel: scaling proxy-cache group 'proxy-cache-prod-us-west' -> desired 6 from 4.

sam: scaling done. also bumping `timeout_ms` in gateway config to 20000 for that route.

incident-bot: note — there are multiple related alerts: 5xx-rate (/v1/generate) firing in us-west-1, gateway-timeout-high in both us-west-1 and eu-west-1. Severity: P2.

iris: metrics after mitigation: 5xx dropped from 8.2% -> 3.1% over 3m window. latency p95 still elevated at ~1.8s (was 1.1s).

eng-sre-lead: good reduction. we should tune alerts to reduce noise and avoid paging for transient bursts. proposal: change 5xx-rate alert to fire at >5% for 5m instead of 1m, and add a secondary alert for sustained >3% for 15m as a paging condition. also add dimensioning by model_version and region. thoughts?

oncall-angel: agree on >5% over 5m for immediate paging. we still want faster signal for SRE dashboards — keep a non-pager 'warning' at >3% 1m to Slack channel only.

sam: add that many of these 502s look like upstream proxy queue exhaustion. can we add a panel to the service dashboard showing `proxy_queue_depth` + `proxy_active_requests` per node and a derived ratio. would help triage next time.

iris: I’ll create the dashboard panel: query suggestion (promql):
```
sum by(instance) (rate(proxy_queue_depth[1m])) / max by(instance) (proxy_capacity)
```
and `histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (region, model)` for latency.
```

eng-sre-lead: also add a synthetic monitor that hits /health and /v1/generate (short prompt) with seq_len=128 from multiple regions every 1m. alert if success_rate < 98% over 5m. non-pager.

oncall-angel: runbook updates: - add guidance to check `proxy_queue_depth` and to scale proxy-cache pool, - fallback route knobs, - when to increase gateway timeout vs. reduce concurrency, - who to page for upstream provider issues. assign to iris for runbook PR.

iris: taking runbook action. will open PR with dashboard panels and runbook changes, and propose alert rule changes in the same PR for review. ETA 2h.

sam: short-term postmortem notes: probable root cause is transient overload in proxy-cache causing 502/504 to surface at the gateway under long-seq KV-heavy requests. mitigations applied: traffic split + scaling + timeout bump.

eng-sre-lead: follow-ups / action items:
- iris: dashboard + runbook + alert-rule PR (ETA 2h)
- sam: add a low-overhead probe to detect queue exhaustion on edge-proxy (ETA 1d)
- oncall-angel: keep incident open and monitor for 2h, if stable convert to post-incident review (ETA 24h)

oncall-angel: monitoring at 10m, 30m marks: 5xx % now steady at ~2.7% across regions. p95 latency trending down to ~1.3s. leaving incident open for follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. page suppressed.

prod-support-bot: Customer-impact note added to incident: 'intermittent 502/504 errors affecting a subset of long requests, estimated 0.6% of total requests during peak.'

eng-sre-lead: will schedule a short blameless postmortem tomorrow. please add any logs, timeline, and relevant dashboards to the incident doc.

oncall-angel: thanks team. will hand off to sam for deeper investigation after my shift. sam, ping me if you need escalation. :thumbsup:

sam: will dig into proxy metrics and upstream call patterns. starting root-cause investigation.

iris: opening PR now — will include alert threshold diffs and reasoning.

oncall-angel: closing note for this thread: if anything spikes, @oncall-angel will re-open and page. Otherwise convert to post-incident review in 24h.
